{{nihongo|'''Ōtokoro Shrine'''|大處神社}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} in Morinishi, {{ill|Makino, Shiga|Q6739696|qid=Q6739696}}, {{ill|Takashima, Shiga|Q845794|qid=Q845794}}, {{ill|Shiga Prefecture|Q131358|qid=Q131358}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}}, and its {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|lt=former shrine rank}} was {{ill|Gō-sha|Q134917316|qid=Q134917316}}. {{nihongo|'''Ōtokoro Shrine'''|大處神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Ōmi Province]].

== Enshrined deity ==
*{{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Ōtojinushi-no-Kami}}

== History ==
It is said to have been founded in 670 (9th year of {{ill|Emperor Tenji|Q314802|qid=Q314802}}), and is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}} listed in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}<ref name="巨樹と花">[http://www.tree-flower.jp/25/ootokoro_jinja_1103/ootokoro_katsura.html 大處神社のカツラ - 巨樹と花のページ] Accessed February 26, 2019</ref>. According to shrine tradition, because white boar, white horse, and white chicken were offered in this shrine land and nearby area to worship Toshigami, there was a rite of offering boar at the Kinensai festival. The Mine-mori family served as the shrine household, and it was the sōsha of Ōtokoro-go, one of the ten villages of Takashima District.
